patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-fashion photography serves as primary content blocks and section dividers, often with minimal text overlays, creating a magazine-like visual flow.

A distinctive, heavy sans-serif typeface is used for the brand logo and large display headings, providing a bold, editorial character, contrasted with a lighter, more standard sans-serif for body text and navigation.
The palette is predominantly monochromatic with white and black, allowing the vibrant colors of the product photography to stand out, with a subtle off-white/beige for background variation.

Hero images exhibit a subtle parallax effect on scroll, and content sections reveal with a gentle fade-in or slide-up as they enter the viewport. The primary navigation transforms into a compact, sticky black bar after scrolling past the initial hero section.
The homepage alternates between large, full-bleed editorial imagery (acting as visual anchors or secondary heroes) and clean, grid-based product displays, creating a dynamic browsing experience.

technique_notes: Uses a scroll-triggered animation library (like locomotive-scroll) to implement subtle parallax on large hero images and to reveal subsequent content sections with a staggered fade-in or slide-up effect as they become visible in the viewport. A larger initial navigation bar is replaced by a more compact, sticky navigation bar that appears from the top after the user scrolls past the hero section.
Achieves a high-fashion, editorial aesthetic by employing full-bleed photography for key visual statements, often with text overlaid directly onto the images using a strong contrast for readability.
Establishes a clear typographic hierarchy by pairing an oversized, heavy display sans-serif for brand and headline impact with a clean, legible sans-serif for all functional and descriptive text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, heavy sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual impact, while body and navigation text are clean and legible in a standard sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used consistently across all elements, including images, buttons, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing between major sections, with product grids maintaining a moderate density.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, editorial use of full-bleed, high-fashion photography as the primary content vehicle, often with minimal text overlays, creating a browsing experience akin to a luxury fashion magazine. This visual-first approach, combined with a strong, distinctive sans-serif typeface for branding, elevates the product display beyond a typical e-commerce grid.
